summary: All 11 KJV quotes are verbatim against Num 21:4-9, John 3:14-16, John 12:32, Gal 3:13; every first-person Moses claim (rod-to-serpent, sea, water from rock, grinding the gold calf, praying, forging the serpent) and the Nehushtan/Hezekiah detail match the source text, and the thread lands soundly on Christ with a grace-anchored, fear-free CTA.

findings.quote_or_claim: 'only a look' / 'lift their eyes' / 'costs you nothing but a look' motif
findings.problem: The 'only a look' / 'lift your eyes' figure recurs across Beats 4, 5, 6, and 7; already trimmed per the status note but still the dominant repeated phrase. Stylistic only — does not affect doctrine or verbatim accuracy.
findings.proposed_fix_text: No change required (stylistic); optionally vary one or two of the later 'a look' restatements for cadence.
